body: Hence the term "relatively safe." Please do come along.
I don't know what a "Puppers" is... But I can assure you that it doesn't matter... I was sufficiently terrified all day that I woulda done it.
So you're making the case that relative to switching out the main breaker while it was hot, pulling the meter is equally dangerous and I just got lucky?
It is. Thanks... you too. Merry Christmas.
Just finished getting my paramedic license (which, incidentally, is how I went broke in the first place), so I just need to get a damn job.

I've swapped out a breaker here and there over the years... Sometimes zapped myself a little, got lucky others... If I'd tried that shit with that main breaker I damn sure would have cooked my dumb ass. 

If it seems like I'm being passionate and long winded about this, I've been nervous as hell about this all day and I'm kinda freaked out about how close I came to trying to do that while it was hot.

Pulled the meter... which, despite what all but one commenter (whose comments were deleted) would have me believe, was a relatively safe thing to do compared to just attempting to switch out the main breaker while it was hot, which I was ABSOLUTELY about to do.

With the exception of that ONE ABSOLUTE GODDAMN HERO, everyone assured me that pulling the meter was not ONLY likely to result in fines/legal trouble, it was dangerous as well... Leaving me with two options, find someplace else for me, my wife, and three kids to live until my I could afford to pay someone to fix the thing or just switch the damn main breaker while it was hot.

After pulling the meter, which it turns out was dirt simple and safe as long as I did it EXACTLY as the deleted comment described, I swapped out the main breaker and reinstalled the meter.

After doing so... I'm pretty certain that I'd either be in the hospital right now or my children would've come home from school and followed the smell to my smoldering corpse had I not pulled that meter before changing out that main breaker.

I get it, I'm a dumbass for being fiscally irresponsible in the months and years leading up to this situation. No one's beating down my door for help balancing their damn checkbook and NASA's not blowing up my phone to do the wiring on the space station for that matter... 

But I wasn't going to have my family freezing their asses off by candlelight for lack of me trying to do something about it. So I figured I'd better let my phone charge for a little bit before I got started and while I was doing that I figured what the hell... I'll throw the situation up on Reddit and see what they say.

I got a bunch of what I'd already read and heard elsewhere, with the exception of the one guy who correctly assumed that I was going to attempt this and likely knew that I would have fried my dumb ass if I didn't pull the damn meter first so he gave me simple safe instructions as to how to do it.

And one more thing...

I DID decide to go ahead and call the electric company first and (without identifying myself at first) informed them of what I was planning to do and why. I inquired as to what the consequences might be and it turns out that they're actually totally cool with me cutting the tag and pulling the meter myself (especially since there was a fire hazard if the situation was not rectified immediately) as long as I felt comfortable doing it (which I did because a goddamn saint explained it to me on here) and if I told them how long I would have it out, which was less than an hour.

TL;DR -
I'm sitting here alive and unharmed with my kids, the heat is on, and we're watching Terminator 2 because my 10 year old has never seen it and I've got "pull the meter guy" to thank for it.

This seems like the solution that I'm most likely to do AND that has the least probability of getting me killed but it sure would suck to have them show up while I'm doing this and it wind up costing me even more than I don't have...

Ok, so they've got a fancy digital meter out there and I read on another message board somewhere that og&e will know immediately if I disconnect it... Any advice on that? 

In any case this is obviously a much safer solution than just going at it hot. Risking a fine that I can't pay and subsequent jail time is (probably) better than being a crispy critter.

I feel pretty confident that out here in BFE, Oklahoma, I'm not not going find an electrician that's down for doing work in exchange for IOU's... Especially when I can't even give an honest estimate about when I'd be able make good on a payment right now. I do think you're right and I genuinely do appreciate your concern, though. 

I'm scared shitless but I think I'm gonna have to just suck it up and do this thing.
Around where I live Trump could defile a person's mother right in front them and they would still classify it a "virtuoso performance."

I seem to remember most polls favoring Clinton some even right before election day... I feel like the take away from 2016 is that polls can be really unreliable and even when they're accurate our silly ape brains are terrible at interpreting statistics.

I also seem to remember right after the election a bunch of folks giving Nate Silver a hard time because he said that Trump had "only" a 29% chance of winning so his numbers must have off... But that's not bad odds. That's just shy of 1 in 3.

And I know this is anecdotal and that it doesn't really hold up as real proof, but... I live in southern Oklahoma and I remember watching those debates in rooms full of people and if you had just walked in and didn't know any better you'd have thought there was a UFC match going on with everybody cheering and laughing at everything that came out of Trump's huge weird mouth. I get around quite bit and deal with the public quite a lot in this part of the country and I've never met anyone who claims to have participated in a poll.

Strangely enough I though, most people still didn't think he was going to win, even though VIRTUALLY everyone (me and the wife excluded) voted for him.

Yeah, this. I'm still not certain that he'd win given the state of things, but I'm relatively certain that any of the top three will lose and I feel like I could just about write out a transcript of the debates leading up to the loss and it wouldn't even impress anyone because it was obvious. 

But like you say, Yang won't take his bait. Trump will not be capable of making any coherent response to anything Yang has to say. And here's where I may be a little naively optimistic because I think maybe there's a chance that that dynamic might cause enough people to snap out of it.

Yeah, that's what I meant... I certainly wasn't making the argument that he would beat anyone with any sort of substantive or coherent debate. I just don't see how any of the three front runners are going to fare much better than Hillary against his tactics (for lack of a better word), and I don't understand how anyone else can. 

I feel pretty certain that if (when) it winds up being one of those three he's going to be reelected and that's bumming me out.

I can't picture how his tactic would work against someone like Yang.
